profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company, traded as CRM, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The material harvested from its site is Slack's AI features page, which describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and build automations. The page describes Slackbot as a personal AI agent in Slack that can help prepare for meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs. Salesforce describes AI in Slack as running inside Slack's trusted boundary, with customer data not used to train large language models and the models hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slack is also described as the conversational interface for Agentforce, so agents built with Agentforce can run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

The site tracks three Salesforce AI products: Slack AI, noted as embedded in messaging with message-corpus exposure; Tableau AI (Einstein), noted for business intelligence embedded AI, natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance; and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce, noted as CRM-embedded AI and agents.

Company records list a CIK of 0001108524 and a most recent revenue of $41,525,000,000 on a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31. Litigation exposure is recorded as 281 cases in California. Several third-party MCP servers are listed for Salesforce, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration and management, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp and related entries for running SOQL queries to retrieve records, fields, and relationships, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deployments, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client.
